name: I want to have a better

messages.content: I want to have a better clock app, to replace my existing google clocks app. It seems so boring, no animations and just plane. I want u to make one with the same functionality and same tabs such as alarms, times, stop watch etc. but give it a more unique feel, different ui. don't take inspiration from Google clocks, make the alarms tab as tiles instead of list. it should include that new Google UI interactive
